description: The refusal of the move: before/after only accepts a SIBLING, that is, an object of the SAME parent. Without this refusal the platform falls into an internal assertion (`InvalidOperationException: Condition is false`) that tells nothing to whoever writes the job. The message has to name the path of the TWO parents and say that, without `into`, move does not change the parent. The clean path is in tests/jobs/refactor-move.json; changing the parent, in tests/jobs/refactor-reparent.json.
expectError: move only REORDERS inside the same parent
